queries: WITH per AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING AVG(amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS o FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_amt, p.avg_amt - o.o AS above_overall FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amt > o.o), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS k FROM kept) SELECT kept.link_to_event, kept.avg_amt, kept.above_overall, kept.avg_amt - km.k AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept CROSS JOIN km ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING AVG(amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_event), kept AS (SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM per_event p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg) SELECT link_to_event, avg_amount, above_overall, avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING AVG(amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM ev), kept AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount, ev.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM ev CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ev.avg_amount > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS m FROM kept) SELECT k.link_to_event, k.avg_amount, k.above_overall, k.avg_amount - km.m AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean km ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Budget rows with a NULL link_to_event are excluded, and events whose amounts are all NULL are dropped because they have no average.
'How far above the overall average' is the event average minus the overall mean of per-event averages (a plain difference, not a percentage).
